# Wizards Next LLP

> Wizards Next LLP is a full-service digital marketing agency based in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India, working in digital marketing and web development since June 2023. It was formed as a joint venture of JR Digital Marketing Services and Arushi Inforbit Solutions. It runs 50+ projects across India (including healthcare clients in Hyderabad, served remotely) plus overseas clients in the USA, Russia and Spain.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Wizards Next LLP (brand: Wizards Next)
- Founder: Ravi Khetan
- Office: No 3, D59/127 A-1-4, Nirala Nagar Rd, Nirala Nagar, Shivepurva, Mahmoorganj, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221010, India
- Phone: +91 80721 99651
- Email: admin@wizards.co.in
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00–19:00 IST; Sunday closed
- Office location: Varanasi only. Hyderabad clients are served remotely; there is no Hyderabad office.
- Services: social media marketing, brand creation, graphic design, content and video, Google and Meta ads, performance marketing, SEO, WhatsApp and email marketing, website, e-commerce and app development
- Book a free call: https://www.wizards.co.in/book
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wizards.digital/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/wizardsdigital/
- LinkedIn: https://in.linkedin.com/company/wizardsnext
